title: Göbeklitepe: Tilki Gogo ile Geçmişe Yolculuk
author: Heval Bozbay
description:
For nearly thirty years, excavations at Göbeklitepe have uncovered fascinating clues about the lives, beliefs, imagination, and social world of the people who once gathered there. But many mysteries still remain unsolved. Why was Göbeklitepe built? How were its giant stone pillars transported and erected without wheels or domesticated animals? 
Guided by Gogo the Fox, a curious and charming companion inspired by the fox carvings found at the site, young readers travel deep into the past to explore towering T-shaped pillars, animal reliefs, mysterious symbols, ancient ceremonies, and the work of archaeologists uncovering humanity’s hidden story.
original_title: Göbeklitepe: Tilki Gogo ile Geçmişe Yolculuk
english_title: Göbeklitepe: A Journey to the Past with Gogo the Fox
